main_body: A palm tree: a leaning segmented trunk with a drooping frond canopy of greens at the top
top_band: none as a separate band; the canopy is an organic mass of green fronds, the trunk is a vertical tan column with dark ring segments
evidence: The object is an organic palm. The canopy of fronds is a volumetric mass seen from slightly above, with lighter greens on top and darker drooping fronds. The trunk is a slim column. There is no flat horizontal top surface to judge against the 3/4 contract. The projection reads as organic/other, not a clean 3/4 top-and-front construction, and the trunk has no top band. Strict reading: fail.

style.evidence: The palm has about 5 green steps in the fronds and 4-5 tan steps on the trunk with dark brown outlines tinted toward the material. Frond leaf shapes are readable with highlight streaks, and trunk rings add some texture. Compared to the Beodeul trees, which have dense leaf clumps in many greens and rich bark and root detail, the palm is a smaller, simpler silhouette with smoother fills on frond blades and trunk segments. It is somewhat thinner than the references, and the dark brown outline is applied fairly uniformly along the trunk. Overall, a careful artist would likely say it is a little less rich than the reference, so it fails strictly.
